latest.title: Liberal ambulance fluids did not reduce sepsis mortality
latest.finding: Hospital mortality 18.0% with liberal fluids (median 1500 mL) versus 18.3% with usual care (median 500 mL), RR 0.98 (95% CI 0.80–1.20); all 17 secondary outcomes similar.

latest.title: Ambulance antibiotics gave no survival benefit in sepsis
latest.finding: Hospital mortality 18.0% with ambulance IM ceftriaxone versus 18.4% with placebo, RR 0.97 (95% CI 0.81–1.17); all 17 secondary outcomes similar.

latest.title: Paragliding festival injuries cluster at landing
latest.finding: 10 of 13 injuries (76.9%) occurred during landing versus 1 during takeoff; lower-limb trauma predominated; 8 patients went by ground ambulance and 1 deceased pilot required helicopter-assisted recovery.
